title: SaveAdHocQueryResponse
description: Result of AdHocQuerySave: the created or updated query ID plus owner and audit metadata. date_added and date_changed are raw pass-through strings.

adhoc_query_id.description: ID of the created or updated query.

owner.description: Display name of the query's owner.

owner_id.description: System user ID of the query's owner.

others_can_modify.description: Indicates whether other users may modify this saved query.

added_by_id.description: System user ID of the user who originally created the query.

added_by_user_name.description: User name of the user who originally created the query.

changed_by_id.description: System user ID of the user who last changed the query.

changed_by_user_name.description: User name of the user who last changed the query.

date_added.description: Raw wire value of the date the query was originally created, passed through verbatim (not parsed to date-time).

date_changed.description: Raw wire value of the date the query was last changed, passed through verbatim (not parsed to date-time).

id_set_register_id.description: Register ID for the ID set associated with the saved query, when applicable.
